_about: 5-minute practice library v1. Each practice fixes one or more rubric gaps, needs only materials found in a government classroom, and comes with a 2-minute CRP demo tip and a next-visit check. Activities come from KVS suggested activities (kv_fln pp.17-21) and NCF-FS section 4.5 strategies; steps, timing and checks are written by VisitCoach.

practices.title: Paired reading
practices.subject: literacy
materials: Textbook or any short story page, one per pair
steps: Pair a stronger reader with a child who is still learning (1 min).
Child A reads one line aloud while pointing to each word; child B follows with a finger.
Swap lines. The partner helps only when the reader is stuck for 3 seconds.
Teacher walks around and listens to 3-4 pairs, noting who needs help.
practices.demo_tip: CRP sits with one pair, models pointing and the 3-second wait, then lets the pair continue.
practices.check: Next visit: ask 3 random children to read one line to you from the day's text.

practices.title: Sound clap and first-sound hunt
practices.subject: literacy
steps: Say a familiar word; children clap once for each syllable.
Ask: what is the first sound? Children say only the sound.
Children find one object in the room that starts with the same sound.
Three children share their object and say its first sound.
practices.demo_tip: CRP leads two words while the teacher watches, then the teacher leads the next three.
practices.check: Next visit: say two words and ask 3 children for the first sound of each.

practices.title: Blend aksharas to make a word
practices.subject: literacy
materials: 8-10 akshara cards made from old cartons, or written on the board
steps: Show two akshara cards; children say each sound.
Children blend the sounds into a word (e.g. क + म = कम) and say what it means.
In pairs, children make one new word from the cards and read it to each other.
Two pairs read their word to the class.
practices.demo_tip: CRP shows one blend slowly, stretching the sounds, then hands the cards to the teacher.
practices.check: Next visit: give 3 children a new two-akshara word to blend and read.

practices.title: Read-aloud with a prediction stop
practices.subject: literacy
materials: Any picture storybook or textbook story
steps: Read the first half of a short story aloud with expression; children only listen.
Stop and ask: what will happen next? Take 3 different answers.
Finish the story.
Ask one 'why' question; children tell a partner, then two children share.
practices.demo_tip: CRP models one prediction stop with a 2-page story; the teacher does the 'why' question.
practices.check: Next visit: ask the teacher which story they read and what children predicted.

practices.title: Picture talk in the home language
practices.subject: literacy
materials: One large picture from the textbook or a poster
steps: Show the picture. Children say what they see in any language they like.
Teacher repeats each answer in the school language, adding one new word.
Write 3 of the children's words on the board and read them together.
Children point to the word and the matching part of the picture.
practices.demo_tip: CRP accepts a child's home-language word warmly and shows how to echo it in the school language.
practices.check: Next visit: look for children's words from picture talk on the board or wall.

practices.title: Living word wall
practices.subject: literacy
materials: Chart paper or a wall section at child height
steps: Pick 3 words from today's lesson that children found interesting.
A child says each word; the teacher writes it large on the wall at child height.
Children read the wall words aloud, pointing.
Each day add words and ask 2 children to find and read a word from earlier.
practices.demo_tip: CRP helps put up the first 3 words and shows the 'find a word' game.
practices.check: Next visit: count the words on the wall and ask a child to read two.

practices.title: Shared sentence starter
practices.subject: literacy
steps: Write a sentence starter on the board, e.g. 'Today I ate ___'.
Two children come up and complete it with their own word; the class reads it.
Every child writes the starter and their own ending (invented spelling is fine).
Three children read their sentence aloud.
practices.demo_tip: CRP models completing one sentence and praises a child's invented spelling.
practices.check: Next visit: look in 3 notebooks for sentences children wrote themselves.

practices.title: One picture, one sentence
practices.subject: literacy
steps: Children look at the picture and tell a partner one thing happening in it.
Each child writes 1-2 sentences about the picture in their own words.
Partners read each other's sentence.
Teacher reads out two sentences that are different from each other.
practices.demo_tip: CRP shows how to praise the idea first and fix only one spelling.
practices.check: Next visit: ask 3 children to read you a sentence they wrote this week.

practices.title: Share it out (equal sharing with objects)
practices.subject: numeracy
materials: 10-20 stones, seeds, bottle caps or beads per pair
steps: Give each pair 10 objects: 'Share these equally between you. How many each?'
Pairs say their answer in words: 'We each got 5.'
Change it: share 12 among 3 friends. Pairs act it out.
One pair draws the sharing on the board; the teacher writes the number sentence.
practices.demo_tip: CRP gives one pair the objects and asks the question, so the teacher sees children do it themselves.
practices.check: Next visit: see whether objects are out on desks during the maths period.

practices.title: Bundles of ten
practices.subject: numeracy
materials: Sticks, straws or matchsticks and rubber bands
steps: Each pair counts out 10 sticks and ties them into a bundle.
Show '2 bundles and 3 loose'. Children say how many: 23.
Teacher says a number; pairs make it with bundles and loose sticks.
Children draw the bundles and write the number.
practices.demo_tip: CRP builds one number with a pair and asks them to explain it to the teacher.
practices.check: Next visit: ask 2 children to show a number like 34 with sticks.

practices.title: Classroom shop
practices.subject: numeracy
steps: Set up a shop: label 5 objects with prices up to ₹20 (₹100 for Class 3).
One child is the shopkeeper; a partner buys two items and pays.
The shopkeeper works out the total and the change; the buyer checks.
Swap roles. Two pairs share how they worked out the change.
practices.demo_tip: CRP plays the buyer once so the teacher sees how children work out change.
practices.check: Next visit: ask a child what two items cost together and the change from ₹20.

practices.title: Show me two ways
practices.subject: numeracy
steps: Give one word problem from daily life (e.g. 15 pencils, 5 children).
Pairs solve it any way they like: objects, drawing or numbers.
Ask: 'How did you find it?' Two pairs with different methods show theirs.
Teacher names both methods as correct and asks which one children like.
practices.demo_tip: CRP asks 'how did you find it?' to one child and shows the teacher how to wait for the answer.
practices.check: Next visit: listen for the teacher asking 'how did you find it?' at least once.

practices.title: Name sticks for fair turns
practices.subject: both
materials: Ice-cream sticks or paper slips with each child's name, in a cup
steps: Ask the question to everyone and wait 3 seconds (thinking time).
Pull a name stick; that child answers. Put the stick aside.
If the child is stuck, give a hint or let them ask a friend, then come back to them.
Use the sticks for at least 3 questions in the lesson.
practices.demo_tip: CRP runs 2 questions with name sticks so the teacher sees back-row children answer.
practices.check: Next visit: see whether name sticks are in use and back-row children get turns.

practices.title: Think, pair, share
practices.subject: both
steps: Ask one 'why' or 'how' question. Children think silently for 10 seconds.
Children tell their partner their answer.
Call on 3 pairs to share what their partner said.
Teacher sums up and praises one specific idea.
practices.demo_tip: CRP runs one round so the teacher hears every child talking at once.
practices.check: Next visit: count how many times children talk to a partner in the lesson.

practices.title: Name what the child did
practices.subject: both
steps: When a child answers, name exactly what they did well ('You split the word into sounds').
When a child makes a mistake, give a hint instead of the answer ('Look at the first sound again').
Let the child try again and praise the second try.
Aim for 5 specific praises in the lesson.
practices.demo_tip: CRP shows one hint-instead-of-answer exchange with a child.
practices.check: Next visit: count specific praises and hints in a 10-minute stretch.

practices.title: Materials in every hand
practices.subject: both
materials: Whatever TLM the school has, or stones, leaves, cards
steps: Before the activity, give each pair or group one set of materials.
Children do the task with the materials (sort, count, match, build).
Teacher moves between groups asking 'what are you doing?'
One group shows the class what they made.
practices.demo_tip: CRP helps hand out materials in under a minute and shows how to collect them back fast.
practices.check: Next visit: see whether TLM is out of the cupboard and in children's hands.
